articles.title: UK banks face 10,000 complaints in 3 months over crypto restrictions
articles.snippet: The U.K. claims to aspire to become a global cryptocurrency hub, an ambition that would appear to be at odds with the attitude to crypto purchases of its major banks.

articles.title: Argentina drops criminal probe into President Milei over crashed memecoin LIBRA
articles.snippet: The judge found that Milei's promotion of LIBRA did not constitute fraud, despite the attention his support drew to the token.

articles.title: India's largest exchange denies hack after sleuths pointed to $16 million in suspicious outflows
articles.snippet: CoinDCX denies its active wallets were hacked after sleuths flagged $16 million in outflows from addresses linked to the India-based exchange.

articles.title: ECB official sees digital euro as key to protecting EU ‘sovereignty’
articles.snippet: Piero Cipollone said the bloc is on track to test real transactions in 2027 and roll out a digital euro as early as 2029, pending legislation this year.

articles.title: Malaysia, Thailand join Singapore’s cross-border stablecoin push
articles.snippet: BLOOM seeks to cut costs by helping financial institutions coordinate cross-border use of stablecoins and tokenized deposits.
